newsitem.title: DENMARK: Coke in deal with Carlsberg.
newsitem.headline: Coke in deal with Carlsberg.

text.p: Danish brewery group Carlsberg AS said Tuesday it reached agreement with Coca-Cola Co. on a joint venture for the production and distribution of Coca-Cola and other soft drinks in Denmark and Sweden.
Carlsberg said in a statement the deal was a natural extension of the companies' long-existing cooperation in Denmark through Carlsberg-owned A/S Dadeko.
It said that the first stage of the joint venture would be to set up a new Coca Cola Nordic Beverages A/S holding company, 51 percent owned by Carlsberg and 49 percent by Atlanta-based Coca Cola Co.

The intention is that CCNB, with headquarters in Copenhagen, will act as holding company for units in the separate countries that are licensed to produce, sell and distribute Coca Cola products, including the Coca Cola, Fanta and Sprite soft drink brands, it said.
